description: This file defines the Tooltip class for the Leaflet mapping library, extending DivOverlay to display small text overlays on map layers. It includes methods for managing tooltip appearance, positioning, and interaction with map and layer events.

classes.name: Tooltip
classes.description: A class for displaying small text overlays on map layers, with configurable options for position, appearance, and interaction.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Handles adding the tooltip to the map, setting opacity, and firing open events.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Handles removing the tooltip from the map and firing close events.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Returns event handlers for the tooltip, including touch-specific behavior.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the tooltip via the map.

methods.name: _setPosition
methods.description: Calculates and sets the tooltip's position based on options and map state.

methods.name: _updatePosition
methods.description: Updates tooltip position based on its geographic location.

methods.name: setOpacity
methods.description: Sets the opacity of the tooltip container.

methods.name: _animateZoom
methods.description: Adjusts tooltip position during zoom animations.

methods.name: _getAnchor
methods.description: Determines the anchor point for the tooltip on its source layer.
